points: 36% of successful sign-ins used a passkey in 2026, up from 26% (participant group changed)
Passkey sign-ins succeed 93% of the time vs 78% for passwords plus MFA
All 8 participants measuring it saw fewer successful phishing attacks
read: FIDO Alliance, Passkey Index 2026 (PDF, October 2026; data compiled 21 September 2026; 15 relying parties incl. Amazon, Google, Microsoft, PayPal)
take: Aggregate data from 15 large services gives CISOs a hard benchmark for phasing out passwords: passkeys sign in more reliably, faster and cut phishing.
title: FIDO Alliance: passkeys now used in 36% of sign-ins
